name: Southsea Freebooters
objectiveText: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and 6 Southsea Cannoneers for Gazlowe in Ratchet.   Southsea Brigand slain  ( 12 )   Southsea Cannoneer slain  ( 6 )

comments.body:
Okay, so you're on the road that leads into ratchet (the ONLY main road into ratchet). You get to coords 61:37. STOP. Turn right (S.E.). You should see Jazzik's General Goods. Go towards it, now go past it (stay to the left side of the buldings). Go past the tavern. You should see a little "pass" looking area (62:39) that you can walk through (don't jump over the fence, just keep going straight).  There might even be a bruiser standing at the entrance. You will notice this is a path. Follow it. You'll run right into them and their camp.

And in case you forgot where he is, when you're done, turn it in at 62:36.

ok if you found the first ones like that other guy did all you gotta do is walk off the side of the cliff and there you are.
just right under your nose! kinda like the comericals!

There are also 4 or 5 locked strongboxes on the ship docked near the first pack of pirates.  You can access the ship by jumping up the spike sticking out of the prow and running up the face of the decking.  The ship is completely empty, so the boxes are unguarded if you can unlock them.
